passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding any other statute, any vendor that provides fraud countermeasures that are contained in and on the paper used for ballots shall be ISO 27001 certified, ISO 17025 certified or ISO 9001:2015 certified.

rows.reasoning: The only instrument in the sources is SB1057 (2026), which Finchem prime-sponsored and voted Y on; its operative section sets security features for ballot paper, titled "fraud countermeasures; paper ballots". The ladder asks how the government should verify a voter's identity and eligibility, and no clause of the bill requires or removes any form of voter identification, so it cannot establish a rung such as "Require photo ID in person and an ID number on every mail ballot." or "Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote." Every passage is adjacent, so no passage survives to support a chair.
